ideas.name: Options Expiration Week Effect
ideas.claim: The S&P 500 gained an average of 0.35% per trade when entered at the close of the week preceding options expiration week.
ideas.quote: Note that if we enter at the close of the trading week preceding the options expiration week, the average gain increases to 0.35% per trade.

rules.entry: Buy at the close of the week preceding options expiration week.
rules.exit: Sell at the close of options expiration day, usually Friday; Thursday if Friday is a holiday.

ideas.claimed_result: Average gain of 0.35% per trade, or 35 basis points; test focused on the period after 1990.
